This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="Lando 3" />

==Biology and appearance==
This bipedal species was distinguished by their hulking stature, large features, wideset [[eye]]s, and [[Color|brown]]<ref name="Han Solo & Chewbacca 5" /> or green skin.<ref name="Lando 3" />

==Species in the galaxy==
[[File:TorraDozaShelf-TheHighTower.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Torra Doza owned a doll of a member of this species.]]
In [[10 BBY]],<ref name="Lando Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> a member of this species served as an enforcer within [[Batalla's outlaws|Batalla's outlaw group]], helping to restrain and lock up [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian]]<ref name="Lando 3" /> who had previously been apprehended.<ref name="Lando 2">[[Lando - Double or Nothing 2|''Lando - Double or Nothing'' 2]]</ref> Later, sometime between [[8 BBY]] and [[2 BBY]],<ref name="Han Solo & Chewbacca Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars: Han Solo & Chewbacca]]'' to between around [[8 BBY]] and [[2 BBY]].</ref> a member of this species could be found at an [[Imperial Impound Facility]] on the [[planet]] [[Iakar]], present when [[Buck Vancto]] arrived to apprehend [[Corbus Tyra]].<ref name="Han Solo & Chewbacca 5" />

By [[34 ABY]],<ref name="Resistance Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' establishes that the events of [[Star Wars Resistance Season One|''Star Wars Resistance'' Season One]], which includes this episode, takes place in [[34 ABY]].</ref> [[pilot]] [[Torra Doza]] kept a stuffed doll version of a member of this species on a shelf in [[Torra's Quarters|her room]] aboard the [[supertanker fuel depot]], the ''[[Colossus]]''.<ref name="The High Tower">{{Resistance|The High Tower}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Sennas-Species-Concept.png|thumb|right|200px|The original concept for Senna created by Christian Alzmann.]]
The species made their [[Canon|canonical]] illustrated debut in the [[2018]] comic issue, [[Lando - Double or Nothing 3|''Lando - Double or Nothing'' 3]], written by [[Rodney Barnes]] and illustrated by [[Paolo Villanelli]].<ref name="Lando 3" /> This species' design was first conceived to represent the character [[Moroff|Senna]], originally intended to be a part of the [[Rogue One]] team seen in the film ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''. Senna was intended to be part of an [[alien]] duo alongside the small character [[Lunak]], though ultimately these two characters were cut from the film, though influencing the eventual duo of [[Baze Malbus]] and [[Chirrut Îmwe]], with the original design for this species undergoing several design changes, eventually becoming the mercenary Moroff, as well as the Canon iteration of the [[Gigoran]] species,<ref name="Rogue One Art">''[[The Art of Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref> and later the Gigoran [[Senna (Gigoran)|Senna]] in the [[2018]] film ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''.<ref name="Solo">''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref> This first piece of art depicting this species created by [[Christian Alzmann]], a concept artist on ''Rogue One''.<ref name="Rogue One Art" />
